definitions.explanation: The year before this one; the previous year. Used to refer to events or states in the year that just passed.

examples.japanese: {去年|きょねん}⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きました→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to Japan last year.

examples.japanese: {去年|きょねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{暑|あつ}かった→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{去年|きょねん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}っています→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: I've been learning Japanese since last year.

examples.japanese: {去年|きょねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しかった→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I went to the beach with friends last summer, and it was really fun.

examples.japanese: {去年|きょねん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|たい}{変|へん}な→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦{一|いち}{年|ねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧⟦でした→です：09485_desu⟧。⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し→引越し：03704_hikkoshi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦し→し：12730_shi⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めました→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: Last year was a tough year. I moved and also started a new job.

notes:
{去年|きょねん} means "last year" and is the ordinary everyday word for it.

YEAR REFERENCE SERIES:
- ⟦おととし→おととし：02895_ototoshi⟧ (also written ⟦{一昨年|いっさくねん}→一昨年：15474_issakunen⟧): year before last
- {去年|きょねん}: last year
- ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧: this year
- ⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧: next year
- ⟦{再来年|さらいねん}→再来年：01417_sarainen⟧: year after next

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {去年|きょねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧: last summer
- {去年|きょねん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: since last year
- {去年|きょねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{今頃|いまごろ}→今頃：11605_imagoro⟧: around this time last year

REGISTER:
- {去年|きょねん}: casual and neutral; the normal choice in conversation
- ⟦{昨年|さくねん}→昨年：10433_sakunen⟧: formal, used in writing, news, and business speech

NO PARTICLE NEEDED:
Like other time words of this kind, {去年|きょねん} attaches directly to the verb as an adverb — {去年|きょねん}⟦{行|い}きました→行く：00119_iku⟧, not 去年⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧行きました. It takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ only when a more specific time is named inside it, as in {去年|きょねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. The same holds for ⟦{昨年|さくねん}→昨年：10433_sakunen⟧.
